daily_scan.notes: Thursday scan, window_start = Wednesday's daily_scan (2026-10-21T06:08:48+09:00) -- an ordinary ~24h window. Of the 48 umbrellas: 18 Sunday-only umbrellas (stage_label 'Approved / marketed' with molecule_class exactly ['non_incretin']) skipped unconditionally per the admin's 2026-09-29 rule, counted as throttled. Of the remaining 30: peptron-pt403 (last_checked 2026-10-21, 1 day ago, and now 21 days since last_updated) fell inside the 2-day quiet-umbrella grace window and was skipped (throttled). The other 29 all had last_checked 2026-10-19 (Monday) or earlier and were due again under the 'check every 3rd day' cadence (checked Monday, skipped Tue/Wed, checked again Thursday) or, for ascletis-asc30, because last_updated had not yet reached the 21-day throttle threshold -- so every one of the 29 was queried once on its single most distinctive alias: AdoXLong, TransCon GLP-1, AX251, ASC30, BICX104, B2227, CAM2056, SYH2082, DW-4321, Quject Sphere/큐젝트스피어, DK-LADS/DKF-MB501, GX-H9, Felcorekibart, HHK001, IVL3003, IVL3021, IVL3008/3016, LY3841136, Mapi semaglutide depot, GA Depot, PharmaShell, Zenagamtide/Amycretin, AUL009, Berobenatide/PF-08653944, PRT-1309, ZT002, GB-7001, NPM-139, Petrelintide. 28 of the 29 reconfirmed existing documentation with no new findings and no stage_label or molecule_class changes. The one exception: dongkook-dk-lads -- a second query (two-query cap) surfaced a 2026-10-15 Dailypharm recap of Dongkook's Oct 6-8 CPHI Worldwide 2026 presence, including Phase 3 results (no figures disclosed) for the 3-month formulation of its Lorelin Depot Injection 11.25mg (leuprorelin) on the same DK-LADS platform; logged as f-2026-10-06-001 (date_basis inferred from the event's start date, single Tier 2 source, confidence unverified). This predates the record's own freshness window (its prior last_checked, 2026-10-19), so it is discovered-late, not a headline item; current_status.last_updated moved to 2026-10-06, molecule_class left unchanged (bar not met by a single Tier 2 source). All 29 stamped checked 2026-10-22. Track B1: all 14 fixed watchlist rows queried (En/Kr per class plus cross-class and other_incretin rows) -- almost every result resolved to an already-tracked program (CSPC SYH9017/SYH2082; Peptron PT403/PT404; Nanexa NEX-22/PharmaShell/Adocia AdoXLong; Daewoong/TionLab Quject Sphere; G2GBio InnoLAMP; InventageLab IVL3021/3024; Owl Bio AUL009/016; Metsera MET-233i; Zealand petrelintide; Novo NN1213/NNC0174-0839, both still too-thin/no disclosed interval) or an out-of-scope mention (Roche CT-388/enicepatide, weekly; a Stanford hydrogel rat-model academic study and Lilly/Camurus FluidCrystal tri-agonist deal, both already on file). One cross-class Korean query (초장기 지속형 비만 주사제 미립구) surfaced a genuinely new, previously untracked program: Amgen's MariTide (maridebart cafraglutide, AMG 133), a GIPR-antagonist/GLP-1R-agonist antibody-peptide conjugate explicitly dosed monthly-to-quarterly, now in nine ongoing Phase 3 MARITIME studies. A follow-up code query (codes_queried: 1) confirmed this on two Tier 1 Amgen sources (a June 2025 MARITIME-program story and the Aug 4, 2026 Q2 earnings release/8-K), clearing all four promotion-bar conditions outright; written up as cand-2026-10-22-001 with status ready_for_promotion (fuzzy_match: none, score 0.0 -- no existing umbrella is Amgen-related). Code harvest surfaced roughly 30 code-pattern strings across Track A and B1 (ASC30/35/36/37/39/48, PT403/PT404, BICX104, B2227, SYH2082/SYH9017, DW4421 [a different, unrelated Daewon compound -- padoprazan, resolved and ignored], DKF-MB501, GX-H9/TJ101, HHK001, IVL3003/3008/3016/3021/3024, LY3841136, NEX-22, AUL009/016/018, MET-097i/MET-233i/PF-08653944, ZT002/ZT003/ZT006, GB-7001, NPM-139, ZP8396, AMG133/MariTide, CT-388, NN1213, NNC0174-0839, ABBV-295/GUB014295, CN121154792A, CT-G32); all resolved to already-tracked aliases/candidates, known parent-molecule identifiers, or out-of-scope siblings except MariTide (codes_unknown: 1, codes_queried: 1, now written up as cand-2026-10-22-001 per above). Rotation list: queried biote-cn121154792a, ct-g32, abbv-295 and pt404 (4 rows, resuming after cursor 'lilly-camurus' and wrapping to the start of the 5-row list) -- all four reconfirmed existing documentation with no new findings (the CN121154792A patent itself could not be independently re-confirmed via search this run, consistent with its existing unverified status; Celltrion CT-G32 still interval-undisclosed, IND targeted Feb 2027; AbbVie/Gubra's ABBV-295 Phase 2 NCT07752979 already on file for cand-2026-09-22-001; Peptron's PT404 patent/BD reporting and the July 2026 Lilly-collaboration-denial history unchanged). B3 cheap pass (2/2 searches spent): re-searched the 2 near_bar pending candidates with the oldest follow_up.last_checked -- cand-2026-09-07-001 Precision Antibiotics and cand-2026-09-20-002 i2o Therapeutics -- both reconfirmed only material already on file, no new dated event for either, promotion_bar.evidence rewritten on both, no status change; stamped follow-up 2026-10-22. Stall rule (free date math): no new stalls this run -- CSPC ZhongQi (cand-2026-09-02-007, now 50 days) and CSPC SYH9017 (cand-2026-09-13-002, now 39 days) remain the already-flagged merge cases (fuzzy 0.58/0.60) pending an admin decision, unchanged from prior runs, and not treated as stalled per the established merge-case convention; the 7 candidates already stalled are unchanged. WebFetch calls this run: dailypharm.com (dongkook CPHI recap) and amgen.com + sec.gov (MariTide evidence) all succeeded directly -- dailypharm.com was previously recorded 'blocked' and is corrected to 'ok'; amgen.com and sec.gov are new entries, both 'ok'. Digest: this run's only finding (dongkook-dk-lads) is discovered-late, not within-window, so it is a lateItem, not a headline finding; its only new candidate (cand-2026-10-22-001 Amgen MariTide) entered directly at ready_for_promotion, so it belongs in escalations, never in candidates per the hard boundary.
